messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer

message.content: **Kevin De Bruyne** is the Premier League’s all‑time leader in assists, having supplied **140 assists** across his career with Manchester City. He has consistently topped the assist charts each season he has played, and as of the 2023‑24 campaign he remains the league’s highest assist provider.
